verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a GPU cloud provider, since console analytics or instance-side agents could be toggled, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or tracking opt-out control. The Usage page (docs-20/49) is billing visibility, and the DCGM monitoring in docs-26 is an adjacent feature, so neither delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
